drivingQuestion: In Shmuel's ruling about the flesh enveloping the majority of the rumen, does 'in its majority' mean torn or removed?
outcomeNote: The unit closes with the dilemma standing; the attempted resolution and its rejection follow in the next unit.

segments.he: וּבָשָׂר הַחוֹפֶה רוֹב הַכָּרֵס בְּרוּבּוֹ. בָּעֵי רַב אָשֵׁי: בְּרוֹב קָרוּעַ, אוֹ בְּרוֹב נָטוּל?
segments.en: Shmuel also said: «Or» if «the flesh that envelops the majority of the rumen» was damaged «in its majority,» the animal is a tereifa. «Rav Ashi raises a dilemma:» Is this referring even to a case «where» the «majority» of the length of the flesh was «torn? Or» is it referring only to a case «where» the «majority» of the flesh was «removed,» but if it was torn along the majority of its length the animal remains kosher?
